vulnerability: Lack of sufficient checks for token minting
criticism: The mintToken function does not check if the contract has enough tokens to mint. This could lead to a potential overflow of the totalSupply and potentially allow an attacker to mint more tokens than intended.

The transferFrom function does not check if the sender has enough allowance to transfer the specified amount of tokens. This could lead to a potential underflow of the allowance and potentially allow an attacker to transfer more tokens than intended.

The burn function does not check if the sender has enough tokens to burn. This could lead to a potential underflow of the balanceOf and potentially allow an attacker to burn more tokens than intended.

vulnerability: Insufficient checks for burning from another account
criticism: The burnFrom function does not check if the sender has enough allowance to burn from the specified account. This could lead to a potential underflow of the allowance and potentially allow an attacker to burn more tokens than intended.

The distributeToken function does not check if the contract has enough tokens to distribute. This could lead to a potential overflow of the totalSupply and potentially allow an attacker to distribute more tokens than intended.
